questions.question: Whom does Amos 6 pronounce woe upon?
options: Those who mourn in sackcloth and ashes
Those who are at ease in Zion and feel secure
Those who flee before the coming army
Those who labor hard in the wide fields from dawn
questions.answer: Those who are at ease in Zion and feel secure

questions.question: What were the complacent doing while not grieved over the ruin of Joseph?
options: Fasting in rough sackcloth and weeping aloud in their deep grief
Lying on beds of ivory, feasting, and drinking wine in bowls
Toiling away in the fields under the hot and blazing sun
Standing guard up on the high walls of the threatened city
questions.answer: Lying on beds of ivory, feasting, and drinking wine in bowls

questions.question: Amos 6 warns that the complacent will be the first to go into exile.
Woe to those who are at _____ in Zion.
They are not grieved over the ruin of _____.
